test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Three bottles of the same capacity are 30%, 40% and 25% full of orange juice, respectively. They are filled up completely by adding apple juice. The contents of the three bottles are emptied into another vessel. What is the percentage of apple juice in the mixture?
solution:
**Given:**

The capacity of three bottles of orange juice is - 30%, 40% and 25%

 

**Concept Used:**

The average capacity of three bottles - (a + b + c)/3

 

**Calculation:**

Average % of orange juice in new vessel

⇒ (30 + 40 + 25)/3

⇒ 95/3 = 31(2)/(3)\%

% of apple juice in new vessel

⇒ 100% - 31(2)/(3)\%

⇒ 68(1)/(3)\%

**therefore, the percentage of apple juice in the mixture is 68(1)/(3)\%**
